summary: Flat west kerb backing onto bush, homes only across the road.
reasons: Bush on the west side of the kerb
Nearest homes 12 m or more, across road
Cars park along this street already

best_section.where: West kerb of Queens Road on the level crest, about 30 m up from the dead end, beside the bush

drivers.seclusion: West side is dense bush and tree canopy; apartments 12 m and houses 19 m away, across the street.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow street with cars parked at the kerb nearby; level crest gives a van a stopping place.
drivers.traffic: Quiet no-through residential street; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents park along it; signs only ban parking weekdays 8am-4pm.

flags: Steep either side: 12-18% grades; best section is the flat crest
Narrow street, a van may restrict passing
sun_shade: Shaded by bush and canopy from the west; open overhead near the crest.
cannot_judge: Whether residents mind a van overnight
